name: SHORT-DESCRIPTION
data: Designed by Maurizio Manzoni for Cattelan Italia, the Thomas double bed evokes an anthropomorphic figure with a headboard that juts out at the sides to create a shell with clearly delineated contours. Soft upholstery softens its shape through elegant patterning with wide stitching in a quilted effect. The raised bed frame is finished in fabric or leather like the headboard and supported by bronze or graphite embossed lacquered steel feet, which feature a central slit. A pleasing contrast is created between the rounded corners of the upholstery and the square shape of the metal feet. Available in fabric, micro nubuck, soft leather, soft leather glove, or synthetic leather, with provided slats as part of the bed structure.
